what_it_does: Introduces LowDiff, a technique for fault tolerance in distributed deep learning training. Training stores checkpoint snapshots periodically to enable recovery if hardware fails. Frequent checkpointing allows faster recovery but generates many large files, consuming storage and wasting time writing to disk. LowDiff reuses gradient information (partial computation results already being communicated between machines) as differential checkpoints—storing only the differences from a prior checkpoint rather than the full state. Includes optimizations for batching gradient writes and dynamically tuning checkpoint frequency.
